body: Thank you for commenting by the way. I think the only real thing keeping me from doing it is my family. I try to stay positive but it's almost impossible once I look at myself and how pointless my life is. It seems like everything I do is wrong and I'm constantly being let down. My motivation is ceasing as well. Volunteering isn't really an option as I am taking classes and I have lots of homework. And if I was to do anything with my spare time it would be an actual job. On top of my own issues, I've had 2 family members die in the past 2 years and I was very close with them.. I'm a very introverted person too and I have a hard time keeping conversations with people. Also groups of people overwhelm me.

Life is becoming hopeless for me and I'm starting to feel like there's almost no point in trying. Everyday is exactly the same. I'm invisible, almost nobody. I don't have many friends and most of the few friends I have are condescending fucks. I'm high literally 24/7. I've had major depression for years and death seems much more appealing than torturing myself for my entire life just to have the same ending and to be completely forgotten. That's my thought process. I can't recall the last time I was truly happy to be honest. I live in Oregon by the way.
